title: TRADE REQUEST [FREE MUSIC] I can make you music, you can make me tilesets/characters/art, (alien jellyfish cafe test game)

posts.author: jellyfish808
posts.body:
Hello!
maybe the title is a little confusing..
My name is
Jellyfish
and I'm a music composer looking to make music for other peoples projects!
Why?
I want experience working with others, to test my music making abilities & hopefully get more recognition as a musician
( all I ask is you
credit
me as '
JELLYFISH808
' where it's used )
For music:
Have a listen to what I make
https://soundcloud.com/dreamh0pp3r
If you like it, tell me about the track you want
(what it's used for etc also just infodump about your project, I love to read and want to to know as much as possible about it),
a track of mine with the most similar vibe to what you want,
and 2 tracks from somewhere else that you want that vibe of.
​
Now, I'm aiming to be a game dev & game artist too, but I'm only dipping my toes in rpg maker, baby steps!!
I have a little test project called
'Lost Time at the Last Cafe'
where you play as a mutated jellyfish alien named
"Bari the Barista"
and they figure out how to make coffees for alien customers at the end of time cafe.
I use
RPG MAKER VX ACE
and in exchange for making you music, I would be very grateful for some
art/tilesets
that I can use for my test project..  for the sake of seeing what can be done & how well I can implement everything.
My project may be posted online to be played for free and I will be sure to credit all art that I use.
Looking for:
Jellyfish art with a barista apron/sprites
Coffee cups with different latte art designs (rosettas, cats, clocks, aliens, jellyfish) all with different coloured liquids
Espresso/piano machine (like a piano and an espresso machine's
love child
)
Alien customer art/sprites
Alien Clock sprites (the clock is the narrator/ cafe owner)
Tilesets for a cute space/time themed cafe
I am making all the sprites myself too, but my art skill is terrible,
so I will keep posted here on my attempts as ideas, but unless I magically become good at art I hope I can replace it with real talented artists work!
Here is my very first test sprite of bari (ew, i know)
